tip-calculator/features/change: Optionally enter the cash you hand over and see the change for every rate
tip-calculator/features/currencies: Switch between US Dollar and Euro
tip-calculator/features/multi_rate: Compare several tip rates side by side
tip-calculator/features/persistent: Custom rates and rounding preferences are remembered in your browser
tip-calculator/features/privacy: All calculations run locally in your browser - nothing is uploaded
tip-calculator/features/rounding: Round totals to real coin and banknote denominations - nearest, up, or down
tip-calculator/how_to_use/step1: Enter the amount shown on the bill, before tip.
tip-calculator/how_to_use/step2: Pick the currency, then choose the denomination and direction to round the total to.
tip-calculator/how_to_use/step3: Compare the tip and total for each rate, or add and remove rates to build your own list.
tip-calculator/how_to_use/step4: To work out change, enter the cash you hand over and see the change for every rate.
tip-calculator/message/duplicate_rate: This rate is already in the list.
tip-calculator/message/invalid_rate: Enter a tip rate between 0 and 100.
tip-calculator/message/max_rates: You can compare up to 8 rates.
tip-calculator/message/paid_too_low: Cash paid is less than the total.
tip-calculator/note: Calculate tips for several rates at once, round totals to real USD or EUR denominations, and work out the change from the cash you hand over - favorite rates are saved in the browser.
tip-calculator/result/empty: Enter a bill amount to see tips and totals.
tip-calculator/result/no_rates: Add a tip rate to start comparing.
tip-calculator/result/rounding_note: Totals are rounded to a multiple of {step}, so paying in cash is easy.
tip-calculator/settings/help/bill: The amount shown on the bill, before tip.
tip-calculator/settings/help/currency: Tips and totals are shown in this currency; each currency remembers its own rounding settings.
tip-calculator/settings/help/mode: Round up to pay slightly more, round down to pay less, or round to the nearest. Ignored when exact.
tip-calculator/settings/help/paid: The cash you actually hand over. Fill it in to see the change for each rate.
tip-calculator/settings/help/step: The total is rounded to a multiple of this denomination, so paying whole amounts in cash is easy.
tip-calculator/tags: tip, gratuity, tipping, bill, restaurant, tip calculator
